title: [finding][repo:objectui] Kanban renders a column for every picklist option, including stages the view's own `filter` excludes — two permanently-empty Closed columns
body:
**Finding, not a claim on anyone's queue** — filed by the video-production lane. Not taking this on.

## What we observed

A kanban view on Opportunity carries a `filter` that excludes the closed stages. The board still renders **one column per picklist option of the group-by field**, so the two Closed stages appear as columns that can never contain a card — the column set comes from the field's options and does not converge with the view filter.

Side effect: the two dead columns push the five live stages wider than the viewport at 1920×1080 (they sit off-screen right), which is what made us notice.

## Why it mattered to us

We had to frame the shot around the dead columns and confirm which stages were on-screen before recording.

## Environment

- `hotcrm` `main` @ `c716a2c` (17.4.0), `OS_PRODUCT_STAGE=ga`
- Opportunity board grouped by `stage`, view filter excludes closed stages, viewport 1920×1080

## What would resolve it for us

Columns derived from the group-by field's options **intersected with what the view filter can admit** — or an opt-in flag on the view to hide empty non-admissible columns.

Context: promo-video ticket steedos-labs/video-studio#356 (private repo; the finding above is self-contained).
